concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将程序控制信号与模型可读叙事分开命名并补充边界。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS named the separation between program control signals and model-readable narrative, then stated its boundary.

concepts.zh_label: 执行型与内容生成型 Agent
concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 按交付对象、状态依赖和错误后果整理为架构选型判据。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS turned delivery object, state dependency, and failure consequence into an architecture-selection test.

concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将叙事、机械参数和任务调度的写入权整理为三个状态平面。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS organized narrative, mechanical parameters, and task scheduling into three state planes with distinct write ownership.

concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 补入 Provenance 来源坐标和调用前 fail-fast 约束。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS added provenance coordinates and fail-fast checks before a tool call.

concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 按目标、追加事实和当前读取视图的不同寿命整理三种结构。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS separated the original goal, append-only facts, and current read view by lifetime.

concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将短期推理轨迹整理为模型、运行时和人工审核共享的工作面。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS restated the short-lived reasoning trace as a shared work surface for the model, runtime, and reviewer.

concepts.adps_zh: 落地结构名为 ReasonContext；“记忆信封”由 ADPS 命名。
concepts.adps_en: The implementation structure is ReasonContext; ADPS supplied the name Memory Envelope.

concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 按当前输入、任务事实和跨任务经验补充加载与引用规则。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS added loading and reference rules for current input, task facts, and cross-task experience.

concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 用 Facade、Mediator 与工作流引擎的历史近邻说明输入输出适配和控制权的边界。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS used the Facade, Mediator, and workflow-engine lineage to state the boundary between I/O adaptation and control.

concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将自然语言入口类比为编译器前端，并明确有限枚举和 unknown 兜底。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS restated the language entry point as a compiler front end with bounded enums and an unknown fallback.

concepts.zh_label: 任务 DAG 与状态机
concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将依赖、验收和恢复统一进 Agent 任务合同。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS placed dependency, acceptance, and recovery in one agent task contract.
concepts.status_zh: 继承术语的 Agent 化

concepts.zh_label: 活动事件与执行时间线
concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将模型、工具、状态变化、耗时和成本整理到同一事件轴。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS organized model, tool, state, latency, and cost events on one timeline.

concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将人工审批整理为可持久化运行状态，并补充恢复前复验。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS treated approval as durable runtime state and added revalidation before resume.

concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 补入模型生成、人工审阅、认证版本和运行权。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS added model generation, human review, certified versions, and execution rights.

concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 区分阶段事实、运行状态和验收证据，并补入单写者约束。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS separated stage facts, runtime state, and acceptance evidence, then added a single-writer constraint.

concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将用户侧探针回执接入任务状态机，用真实结果裁决成功。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS connected a user-side probe receipt to the task state machine so observable results decide success.

concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 要求失败记录回链规则、测试、默认值或能力资产，并验证防复发。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS requires a failure record to change a rule, test, default, or capability asset and then verify non-recurrence.

concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将认证对象扩展到管线、Skill、工具封装与子流程，并明确自动运行权。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS extended certification to pipelines, skills, tool wrappers, and subflows, with explicit automatic execution rights.

concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 依据公开机制还原阶段合同，并明确候选 IR、验证器和写入器的职责。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS reconstructed the stage contracts and separated candidate IR, validation, and write-back responsibilities.

concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将图类型、工程范围、候选结构、回执和撤销合成一次写回边界。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS combined diagram type, model scope, candidate structure, receipt, and undo into one write-back boundary.

concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将工程不变量检查连到真实写回回执和结果状态。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS connected engineering-invariant checks to the actual write-back receipt and result state.

concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将澄清字段、候选对象、恢复游标和宿主版本放进同一作业合同。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS placed clarification fields, candidate objects, a resume cursor, and host revision in one job contract.

concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将词表映射整理为按图类型和宿主版本选择的可测试运行资产。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS restated vocabulary mapping as a testable runtime asset selected by diagram type and host version.

concepts.origin_en: First proposed within ADPS by Jia Huang
concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将现场到模式、再回到现场的往返整理为模式审校方法。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS formalized the round trip from field evidence to pattern and back as a review method.

concepts.origin_zh: 工程判断：张栋；整理命名：ADPS
concepts.origin_en: Engineering observation: Dong Zhang; name formalized by ADPS
concepts.adps_zh: 张栋提出串行、并行、路由是常见运行原语；ADPS 补入高层责任语义的保留规则。
concepts.adps_en: Dong Zhang identified serial, parallel, and routing as common runtime primitives; ADPS added rules for preserving higher-level responsibility semantics.

concepts.origin_en: First proposed within ADPS by Dong Zhang
concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 按公开口径整理身份、权限、防护和溯源四层检查表。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS edited the four-layer identity, authority, safeguard, and provenance checklist for public use.

concepts.origin_zh: 初始问题与建议：王伟；字段结构：ADPS
concepts.origin_en: Initial problem and proposal: Wei Wang; field structure: ADPS
concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将不同团队的 Handoff 协议差异整理为目标、产物、决定、权限和验收字段。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS organized differing handoff protocols around goal, artifacts, decisions, authority, and acceptance.

concepts.origin_en: First proposed within ADPS by Wei Wang
concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将 Agent-Agent、Human-Agent 和 Agent 环境中的 Human-Human 关系整理为统一设计视角。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS organized Agent-Agent, Human-Agent, and Human-Human relations around the agent environment into one design view.

concepts.origin_zh: 初始问题与实践：王伟；分类整理：ADPS
concepts.origin_en: Initial problem and practice: Wei Wang; classification formalized by ADPS
concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 区分编排、治理、观测和恢复四类职责，并补充顺序、幂等和失败语义。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS separated orchestration, governance, observation, and recovery duties and added ordering, idempotency, and failure semantics.

concepts.zh_label: 概率内核与确定性外壳
concepts.origin_zh: 工程判断：张栋；外壳表述：黄佳
concepts.origin_en: Engineering observation: Dong Zhang; shell formulation: Jia Huang
concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将模型的开放判断与身份、状态、权限、测试和外部回执的确定性控制连接起来。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS connected open model judgement to deterministic controls over identity, state, authority, tests, and external receipts.

concepts.origin_zh: ADPS 研讨会初始引入：张颖峰
concepts.origin_en: Introduced into ADPS workshops by Yingfeng Zhang
concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将其整理为 M2 写入侧机制，并保留这一术语已有公开技术前史的说明。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS placed it on the write side of M2 while recognizing that the term has a broader public technical lineage.

concepts.origin_zh: 初始议题：黄佳；工程实践：黄湘龙；整理命名：ADPS
concepts.origin_en: Initial question: Jia Huang; engineering practice: Xianglong Huang; name formalized by ADPS
concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将 Why、What、How、验收材料与 P1/P2 的信息边界整理为可测试合同。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS organized Why, What, How, acceptance material, and P1/P2 information boundaries into a testable contract.

concepts.origin_zh: ADPS 内初始提出：茹炳晟；实践补充：王伟、Pylon PENG
concepts.origin_en: First proposed within ADPS by Bingsheng Ru; practice discussed by Wei Wang and Pylon Peng
concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将合法性、依赖、权限、冲突和经济性检查整理为计划进入执行前的编译步骤。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS organized legality, dependency, authority, conflict, and economy checks into a compilation step before execution.

concepts.origin_zh: ADPS 内初始提出：李佳奇；整理命名：ADPS
concepts.origin_en: First proposed within ADPS by Li Jiaqi; name formalized by ADPS
concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将即时结果与跨部门、跨任务的延迟业务结果整理为两个反馈时钟。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS named the separation between immediate results and delayed business outcomes across teams and runs as two feedback clocks.

concepts.origin_zh: ADPS 内初始提出：徐一博
concepts.origin_en: First proposed within ADPS by Yibo Xu
concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将研讨中的 Durable Intent 连接到 G1 审批门，并补充 Intent、Approval、Execution 三段记录。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS connected Durable Intent to G1 Approval Gate and organized Intent, Approval, and Execution as three records.

concepts.origin_zh: 初始问题：唐洪山；实践补充：Pylon PENG、王伟；整理命名：ADPS
concepts.origin_en: Initial problem: Hongshan Tang; practice discussed by Pylon Peng and Wei Wang; name formalized by ADPS
concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将文件冲突扩展到编号、配置、数据库记录、测试环境和外部资源。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS extended file conflicts to identifiers, configuration, database records, test environments, and external resources.

concepts.origin_en: First proposed within ADPS by Jia Huang
concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将信息影响决策、标准裁决结果和权限改变现实世界区分为三种权力。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS separates the power to influence decisions, judge results, and change the external world.

concepts.origin_en: First proposed within ADPS by Jia Huang
concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将需求、测试、评审、部署和业务结果中的裁判类型及其交接整理为生命周期问题。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS treats the changing judge across requirements, tests, review, deployment, and business outcome as a lifecycle concern.

concepts.origin_en: First proposed within ADPS by Jia Huang
concepts.adps_zh: ADPS 将单步动作合规与长程目标漂移分为两个同时运行的治理尺度。
concepts.adps_en: ADPS separates per-action compliance from long-horizon goal drift as two concurrent governance scales.
